Free sample: scope-creep triage sheet

A free 3-page printable PDF for handling "can you just also..." requests from clients. No sign-up: the link downloads the file directly.

What's in it

  • A four-box triage table for sorting a request: tiny favour, new deliverable, extra revision round or changed goal. Includes a tip for when you're not sure which box it fits, a rule of thumb for your free-favour threshold and a blank line to write your own.
  • A five-part reply structure, in short form.
  • One example email: a reply to a request for a new deliverable.
  • A filled-in change request for a fictional client, plus a one-line way to explain your change process at kickoff.

Everything in it comes from our article The "that's extra" email, shortened and rearranged to print. It is not legal advice and not a contract.

Download the PDF (scope-creep triage sample)

PDF, 3 pages, A4, about 60 KB.

The full kit

The sample is a small part of the Scope Guard & Client Onboarding Kit, which also includes a blank change-request form, a change log, more email scripts, AI prompts and intake, scope-summary and kickoff templates.
